stencilVolumeDraw.renderTarget: same lighting attachment and depth as event 443

comparisonWithD3D11: Same pass order: GBuffer -> CopyDepth -> Deferred Shading (Stencil) -> Forward Only -> Skybox -> Transparent -> FinalBlit.
D3D11 baseline had 2 fullscreen deferred draws (2 lights); this D3D12 baseline has 2 fullscreen + 6 stencil light volumes (more lights), confirming per-light draw scaling on both APIs.
Lighting attachment and depth formats match: R11G11B10_FLOAT + D32S8.
Forward-only is still a separate pass after deferred lighting, matching the mask=0 design (D16).
